toolArgs: {"command":"cd \"<repo>\" && MIG=\"prisma/migrations/$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)_<name>\" && mkdir -p \"$MIG\" && \\\n  npx prisma migrate diff --from-migrations prisma/migrations \\\n  --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma \\\n  --shadow-database-url \"$(grep -E '^DATABASE_URL=' <path>/.env | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '\\\"')\" \\\n  --script > \"$MIG/migration.sql\""}
